rules.statement: Give exactly one of `repricing` and `repricing_absence`; `repricing.bps` is a whole number of basis points from 0 to 1000.
`paths` holds exactly one row for each `kind` (repay_from_resources, amend_and_extend, market_refinancing, asset_sale_or_equity, liability_management), none missing and none twice.

Every analyst text (`repricing.rationale`, the absence `reason` and `follow_up`, and each path's `text`, `credit_implication` and `limitation`) is nonblank, has no digit, states no instrument recommendation or recovery conclusion, no refinancing outcome (`will be refinanced`, `will refinance`, `refinancing is assured`, `refinancing is certain`, `will default`), no `fulcrum` or `headroom is sufficient`, and no compliance word (complies, compliant, compliance, breach, met, satisfied and their forms) within four words of `covenant`.
Every `basis_refs` entry is a `ref` listed under `facts` in the module context; a path whose feasibility is High, Medium or Low lists at least one.
A path's `feasibility` is Insufficient Information exactly when its `category` is. An Insufficient Information path states its `limitation`; any other path has a null or empty `limitation`.
The `liability_management` path always has feasibility Insufficient Information, because the legal covenant capacity evidence it needs is not bound.
